_meta.description: Names that came up in source memos but were deliberately NOT added to the dashboard, with the reason. Scope discipline is value: this list documents the curation rules so the 'why isn't X here?' question is answered. Categories: software-saas, payments-fintech, cybersecurity, auto-oem, av-services, defense-pure, service-robots, raw-materials (→ Hard Assets sibling), bitcoin-infra, speculative, lagging-edge-memory, ticker-conflict, end-customer.

categories.software-saas: Software / SaaS layer — out of scope for a hardware dashboard
categories.payments-fintech: Payments rails / stablecoin / fintech — out of scope
categories.auto-oem: Auto OEM end-customer — not a supply-chain chokepoint

categories.service-robots: Service / sidewalk / hospitality robots — niche, not chokepoint

categories.speculative: Too speculative or too binary-outcome for the curated map

categories.ticker-conflict: Source had a likely-wrong ticker; deferred until verified
categories.end-customer: Pure end-customer (hyperscaler / brand) — not a supply chain layer
